name: genui-spectrum-json-render
description: Part 04: the json-render catalog (Zod) + React registry bundled for the browser, and a Node checker the Python server calls.

scripts.build: esbuild app.mjs --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/jr-app.js --external:/shared/* --define:process.env.NODE_ENV=\"production\" --minify --log-level=warning && esbuild check.mjs --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/check.mjs --minify --external:/shared/* --log-level=warning && node prompt.mjs
